subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When an invocation completes, the gate shall return one structured verdict (closed schema) classifying the contract as `clean` or one of `incomplete`/`malformed`/`stale`/`unresolved`/`error`/`configuration-error`, recording the identity of what it evaluated — each input's content fingerprint and the gate version — and shall represent a pass as **"mechanically clean," never "executable."**
rationale: the verdict is the trust artifact; it must name what it certifies and must not over-claim past the mechanical scope (`#D-7`; AP-13)
fit_criterion: every fixture run's verdict validates against the schema, enumerates each check's result, and records the input fingerprints; no verdict labels a mechanically-clean pass as a full stage-6 pass; the semantic-verdict fields exist in the schema and are marked not-evaluated in v1
